name: VEX V5 Pushing Drive (torque)
description: Slow, strong 4-motor VEX V5 drive for pushing matches: 4 x 11 W Smart Motors with green (200 rpm) cartridges driving 3.25 in traction wheels directly. Traction wheels resist being pushed sideways but scrub more in turns. Motor numbers are VEX's published ratings; mass and size are typical values, not measurements of one robot.
